# Accordion item: `jl-accordion-item`

A section that opens and closes under its heading: a disclosure, or one item of an accordion.

- Class `JlAccordionItem`, a molecule: `import { JlAccordionItem } from '@syware/jlib';`
- On the site: https://bioleyl.github.io/jlib/components/accordion-item

A section that opens and closes under its heading, built on the browser's details and summary: the
heading is a button for the keyboard and screen readers, and the chevron turns as the content slides open.

Alone it is a disclosure ("Show more details"); in a jl-accordion it is one of a list. toggle fires with the new state,
whether people or code opened it.

## Use

```ts
import { JlAccordionItem } from '@syware/jlib';
```

```tsx
<JlAccordionItem
  heading="What does the free plan include?"
  icon="circle-help"
>
  Three projects, five people and a week of history. Upgrade when you need more.
</JlAccordionItem>
```

```html
<jl-accordion-item
  heading="What does the free plan include?"
  icon="circle-help"
>
  Three projects, five people and a week of history. Upgrade when you need more.
</jl-accordion-item>
```

## Properties

Inputs: a JSX prop sets one, code calls `.set(value)` and `.get()`, HTML writes the attribute (lists and objects as JSON).

- `heading` (attribute `heading`): `string`, default `''`. The text of the heading that opens and closes the item.
- `description` (attribute `description`): `string`, default `''`. A quieter line under the heading, shown open or closed: what the item holds.
- `open` (attribute `open`): `boolean`, default `false`. The content shows.
- `icon` (attribute `icon`): `string`, default `''`. An icon name, drawn before the heading. The icon slot takes a richer one instead.
- `disabled` (attribute `disabled`): `boolean`, default `false`. People cannot open or close it.

## Events

In JSX, the `on…` prop, its handler given the detail; in code, `events.register(name, (detail) => …)`. They do not bubble.

- `toggle` (`onToggle` in JSX), detail `boolean`: The item opened (true) or closed (false).

## Slots

- The default slot: The content under the heading.
- `icon`: An element drawn before the heading instead of the icon: a coloured badge, an avatar.

## Styling

- `base` (part, `::part(base)`): The native details element.
- `--pad-x` (custom property): The space at the left and right of the heading and the content (0 alone, 16px when bordered).

## Examples

HTML as the site renders it, with its layout classes (`row`, `stack`, `narrow`, `muted`), which are not jlib's: a view writes the same components by class in JSX. A script's `root` is the example's element.

### A disclosure

```html
<div class="narrow">
  <jl-accordion-item heading="Show the request details">
    <p class="muted">POST /v1/payments · 201 Created · 182 ms</p>
  </jl-accordion-item>
</div>
```

### Icon and disabled

An icon before the heading; a disabled item cannot be opened or closed.

```html
<div class="narrow">
  <jl-accordion-item heading="Shipping" icon="package" open>
    <p class="muted">Free over CHF 50. Ships within two working days.</p>
  </jl-accordion-item>
  <jl-accordion-item heading="Returns" icon="refresh" disabled>
    <p class="muted">Returns open after delivery.</p>
  </jl-accordion-item>
</div>
```

### With a description

A quieter line says what the item holds, open or closed.

```html
<div class="narrow">
  <jl-accordion-item heading="Invoice" description="3 fields, 2 pages" icon="file-text" open>
    <p class="muted">Number, date and total, read from the PDF.</p>
  </jl-accordion-item>
  <jl-accordion-item heading="Email" description="From billing@example.com" icon="mail">
    <p class="muted">The message the invoice came with.</p>
  </jl-accordion-item>
</div>
```

### Opened from code

open is a property too: set it from code, and listen to toggle.

```html
<div class="stack narrow">
  <jl-accordion-item class="demo-item" heading="Advanced options">
    <p class="muted">Timeouts, retries and the region.</p>
  </jl-accordion-item>
  <div class="row">
    <jl-button class="demo-toggle" size="sm" label="Toggle from code"></jl-button>
    <span class="muted demo-state">Closed</span>
  </div>
</div>
```

```js
const item = root.querySelector('.demo-item');
const state = root.querySelector('.demo-state');
item.events.register('toggle', (open) => { state.textContent = open ? 'Open' : 'Closed'; });
root.querySelector('.demo-toggle').events.register('press', () => item.open.set((open) => !open));
```
